title: Minimax Rates for Estimating Powered Sliced Wasserstein Functionals
abstract: arXiv:2610.12740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the two-sample estimation of the powered Sliced Wasserstein functional under projected $r$-th moment assumptions. Let $N=n\wedge m$, where $n$ and $m$ are two sample sizes. We establish the minimax rates in the noncritical regimes. When $p<2p$, the minimax risk is of order $N^{-(r-p)/r}$, while for $r>2p$ it is of order $N^{-1/2}$. In both cases, the natural plug-in estimator is minimax rate-optimal. At the endpoint $r=p$, the minimax risk is bounded away from zero, so uniformly consistent estimation is impossible. At the critical order $r=2p$, we obtain the exact worst-case rate of the plug-in estimator and a lower bound for the minimax risk, leaving a logarithmic gap between the lower and upper bounds. The exact minimax rate in this critical case remains open.

translated_title: 幂次切片Wasserstein泛函估计的极小极大速率
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在投影 $r$ 阶矩假设下幂次切片Wasserstein泛函的两样本估计问题。令 $N=n\wedge m$，其中 $n$ 和 $m$ 为两个样本量。我们建立了非临界情形下的极小极大速率：当 $r<2p$ 时，极小极大风险为 $N^{-(r-p)/r}$ 阶；而当 $r>2p$ 时，为 $N^{-1/2}$ 阶。在这两种情形下，自然的代入估计量均达到极小极大速率最优。在端点 $r=p$ 处，极小极大风险具有不趋于零的下界，因此一致相合估计是不可能实现的。在临界阶 $r=2p$ 处，我们得到了代入估计量的精确最坏情形速率以及极小极大风险的下界，但上下界之间存在一个对数差距，该临界情形下的精确极小极大速率仍是悬而未决的问题。
tldr: 本文建立了幂次切片Wasserstein泛函两样本估计的极小极大速率——当 $r<2p$ 时为 $N^{-(r-p)/r}$ 阶，当 $r>2p$ 时为 $N^{-1/2}$ 阶——并证明自然的代入估计量在两种情形下均达到速率最优。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the minimax rates for two-sample estimation of powered Sliced Wasserstein functionals—of order $N^{-(r-p)/r}$ when $r<2p$ and $N^{-1/2}$ when $r>2p$—and proves that the natural plug-in estimator is minimax rate-optimal in both regimes.
